title: Cloud Security: portfolio pricing
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for portfolio pricing.

## Basis

Portfolio usage threshold: Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal.

Portfolio discount fraction: Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Portfolio usage threshold | Portfolio discount fraction |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 25000 | 0.025 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 25000 | 0.03 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 25000 | 0.035 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 25000 | 0.04 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 25000 | 0.045 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 25000 | 0.05 |

## Tier comparison

For portfolio discount fraction, the 50 Workloads tier lists 0.025 and the 2500 Workloads tier lists 0.05.
